status: Default ladder. Thresholds, settings and patterns are starting values to be tuned on a validation split. 2026-10-11: BERT wins at >= bert_high (0.50), or at >= bert_low (0.25) with a lead >= bert_lead (0.10) over its second choice. Below bert_low the keyword model wins when clear (title hit); otherwise the two models' top 3 page types are compared. Below bert_unknown (0.10) the page is Unknown.

inputs.bert: model_type with a confidence (softmax probability). Implies page_type; implies page_subtype only when page_type is Progress Note.
inputs.keyword: page_subtype with a score, a margin and a title_hit flag (from keyword_canon.json). Implies page_type and model_type.
inputs.page_order: chart_id and page_index for every page. Needed only by level 3.

confidence.comment: The page type's confidence (page_classification.confidence, review-ui 'Page Type' confidence) follows the ladder step that decided it. b = BERT's probability. k = the keyword model's confidence: keyword_title_base (title hit) or keyword_body_base, plus keyword_per_margin per point of margin over the next page type, capped at keyword_title_cap / keyword_body_cap. agreement: 1 - (1-b)(1-k), capped at agreement_cap. bert_high / bert_medium / bert_low / unknown: b. keyword_only_class / keyword_title / keyword_body: k. top3_agreement: the lower of b and k. A step that flags the page for review is capped at review_cap. no_prediction: none. Blank/junk pages keep the blank/junk confidence.

inside_progress_note.comment: v24 Final rules (imaging_final, arbitration.decide_final). A page whose Final family becomes the section L1 (Progress Note) — continuing a Progress Note document, or embedded_families on a page headed by a Progress Note title — takes the document's codability, except a page carrying one of non_codeable_names (any of its canon page type / L3 / L2 / L1), which stays Non-Codable. Final L1 and L2 always agree with the v24 hierarchy (page_canon_v24.json paths): inside a Progress Note, a page of an embedded_families family is Progress Note / its own L2 (else its family), e.g. Progress Note / Medication List; inside any other document, a page keeps its own name as L2 only when the hierarchy places it under that L1; otherwise L1 / Others.

document_agreement.comment: Across a continuity document every page takes the first page's page type (sub-types stay per page). Only when the first page is Unknown, a vote of the pages' types weighted by page-type confidence decides. The vote counts only when one type holds at least vote_min_share of the weight; below that the pages keep their own types and are flagged for review (no_agreement).

level_1_page_type.name: agreement
level_1_page_type.when: BERT and keyword give the same page_type

level_1_page_type.name: bert_high
level_1_page_type.when: they differ and BERT confidence >= bert_high, or BERT confidence >= bert_low with a lead >= bert_lead over BERT's second choice

level_1_page_type.name: keyword_only_class
level_1_page_type.when: they differ, the keyword page_type is a class BERT was not trained on (too few images), and keyword score >= keyword_min_score with title_hit

level_1_page_type.name: keyword_title
level_1_page_type.when: they differ, BERT not high (step 2 did not apply), keyword has title_hit and margin >= keyword_min_margin

level_1_page_type.name: bert_medium
level_1_page_type.when: they differ and BERT confidence >= bert_low

level_1_page_type.name: unknown
level_1_page_type.when: a BERT model is loaded and its confidence < bert_unknown

level_1_page_type.name: top3_agreement
level_1_page_type.when: a page type appears in both BERT's and the keyword model's top 3: the one with the best combined rank (ties: BERT's order)

level_1_page_type.name: keyword_body
level_1_page_type.when: BERT confidence < bert_low and keyword score >= keyword_min_score

level_2_page_subtype: If the winning page_type is Progress Note: use BERT's model_type when BERT's page_type is Progress Note; otherwise use the keyword sub-type when it belongs to Progress Note; otherwise the generic sub-type.
For any other winning page_type: use the keyword sub-type when it belongs to that page_type and its score >= keyword_min_score; otherwise the generic sub-type (same name as the page type).

level_3_continuation.what: On the continuity stage's documents (continuity_canon.json), in imaging_final: every page of a document takes its first page's page type; its own page type becomes the sub-type when it differs (Progress Note / Laboratory Data). Only when the first page is Unknown does a confidence-weighted vote decide (document_agreement). A page in no multi-page document keeps its own type, except embedded_same_page (a Laboratory Data / Radiology Report page with a Progress Note title on it).

level_4_codability: Read codability from the final page_type, after level 3. No model predicts it. An embedded lab or radiology page is therefore codable as Progress Note.
model_type_of_final_answer: page_subtype when page_type is Progress Note, otherwise page_type. For an embedded page this gives Laboratory Data or Radiology Report, the same class BERT predicts for a stand-alone one.

axes.comment: The v24 page axes: they decide page_classification.page_type / page_subtype (L1 / L1, L1 / L2, or 'L1 (L2)' / L3) and the category; the whole answer is in page_classification.axes. Each level is decided by the model when it clears its gate, otherwise by the v24 keyword canon (page_canon_v24.json) when the canon is sure enough; otherwise the column is NULL. axes.sources says which decided each level (model / canon / -). L1 from the model: route 'model' = top L1 >= route_model, ahead of the second by >= route_margin, not the folded OTHER class ('canon' = OTHER or >= route_canon, else 'review'; only 'model' lets the model decide). L1 from the canon: the best L1 among all canon entries, keyword confidence >= canon_min. L2 (not under section_L1, whose L2 is the content section from section tagging): the model's when the model decided L1 and L2 >= l2_min; else the canon's best L2 under that L1, >= canon_min. L3: always the canon's best L3 under that L1 > L2, keyword confidence >= l3_canon_min; the model's L3 is kept in axes.prediction only. Keyword confidence is page_arbitration.json → confidence (title hit 0.60, body 0.30, +0.05 per point of margin, capped). Specialty: the model's when it is not one of specialty_not_asserted, >= specialty_min, ahead of the second by >= specialty_lead, and trained on >= specialty_min_train_pages pages; else the specialty of the canon entry that decided the deepest level, when it has one. Codeability is always the canon's: the tag of the canon page type behind the decided path (the best keyword match among the entries under L1 [> L2 [> L3]], else the entry for exactly that path); needs_review when its rule is context (the Final step resolves it from the page's document) or source. The model's codeability is kept in axes.prediction only. Tune with training/bert-training/tune_thresholds.py on predictions_val.csv.
